title: Sync a warehouse person- or group-property source now
description: Person- and group-property sources only: run what the source reads now. A table binding re-runs a real (billable) warehouse sync; a view binding materializes the view. The incremental person/group-property update rides off that run. It does not reset the recurring schedule. Returns 400 for a source that is not an enabled person- or group-property source, and for a view whose data-modeling DAG is not on the v2 schedule (use backfill there instead). Syncing a group-target source additionally requires the `group:write` scope.
